city is the main other term, and it needs a polynomial in v plus a v·cos/sin(wt) cross term to reduce the error from about 1.4e-2 to 5e-4.

I ran out of budget before finding the physical form behind the v-dependence and the cross term, so this is a numerical approximation rather than the exact law.

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    C = np.cos(params[0]*t); S = np.sin(params[0]*t)
    return (params[1] + params[2]*v + params[3]*v**2 + params[4]*v**3
            + params[5]*C + params[6]*S + (params[7]*C + params[8]*S)*v + params[9]*x**3)
